name: Suzueda Yuka
source:
Kouji's childhood friend. She dated Kouji a few times in the past, but all those relationships ended in failure. Since moving to Tokyo, the awkwardness from their breakups has faded,
and they’re now back to hanging out as friends like they used to. Deep down, she still has lingering feelings for Kouji, but she’s given up, believing they’ll never get back together. She actually has a strong sex drive, and sometimes worries that her lingering feelings for Kouji might be due to that.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01002764.html/]dlsite[/url]]
